free_tier.stated: 'new-user trial: join the group, fill in the application form and immediately receive CNY 50 of compute credit, equivalent to 24 hours of a 4090' and 'deep support: after joining the group and submitting the form, individual developers who pass review receive from CNY 200 a month of ongoing compute support and up to CNY 1,500 in total compute resources'. Preferred profiles, any one of: a product with 10,000 monthly active users, a GitHub project with 100 or more stars, or technical content with 10,000 views or an account with 10,000 followers. Credit is issued as platform points and cannot be converted to cash.

chaining: It chains with nothing at this size, and that is the reason to record it: CNY 50 buys about 24 hours of a single 4090, which is a smoke test and not a workload. It is the honest floor that shows how far the CNY 1,000,000 award sits from anything an individual obtains without a review. Rate card on the vendor's pricing page, column '小时时长包 (8 卡)' (hourly duration pack, marked 8 cards, in CNY): RTX 4090 24 GB 15.84, L40S 48 GB 39.84, A100-80G 80 GB 91.20, H100 80 GB 180.00; the rows also carry 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day packs (RTX 4090 24 GB: 368.76, 2503.85, 9443.08), and only the hourly column is marked 8 cards. No L4 row. The pricing page states no minimum bill.

limits.value: The no-threshold tier is only CNY 50, about 24 hours of one 4090; anything above that needs a review and, in practice, an existing audience or repository.

notes: NAME COLLISION, and it matters: Gongji and Qiji are different companies whose names transliterate similarly. Searches for one surface the other. Gongji is a commercial shared-compute marketplace selling 4090 and H20 time by the second; Qiji is the accelerator running the municipal compute grant. Do not merge these records. Answering the subsidiary question directly: MiraclePlus publishes no trial tier, no GPU-hour taster and no self-service allocation. The only zero-friction thing it offers is the right to submit an application. This plan is the nearest genuine no-review trial found in the same search space, and it belongs to a different vendor at roughly one two-thousandth of the Qiji ceiling.
